statement: You are given an array prices, where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i.
You may make as many trades as you like, holding at most one share at a time. After you sell, you must wait one day before buying again: you cannot buy on the day right after a sale.
Return the largest total profit you can make.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 0 (1), sell on day 1 (2), rest on day 2, buy on day 3 (0), and sell on day 4 (2): 1 + 2 = 3.
The price only falls, so making no trade is best.
